tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background (warm paper in light, deep night in dark). Default ground for all screens.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, table rows, inputs. Sits on `bg`.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells, neutral pills, segmented-control tracks, empty timeline lanes. Slightly darker than `bg` in light, slightly lighter in dark, so it always reads as a recessed well.

tokens.name: hero
tokens.usage: The ClockCard and other single hero panels; stays dark in both themes. Text on it is `on-hero`.

tokens.name: on-hero
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `hero`.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Toasts, tooltips and the reversed lockup ground. Text on it is `ink-inverse`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-sunken` and every `shift-*` tint.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata, captions, table headers. Legible on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders, disabled labels, axis ticks. Reads on `surface` and `bg` (4.5:1); never for essential copy on `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on `surface-inverse`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders (decorative, 1px).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders: 3:1 against `surface` and `bg` in both themes.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Ritmo Green. Primary buttons, selected states, links, the mark. Text on it is `on-brand`.

tokens.name: brand-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of `brand` fills.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Selected rows, active nav item background, success callouts. Text on it is `brand-text` or `ink`.

tokens.name: brand-text
tokens.usage: Brand-colored text and links on `bg`, `surface` and `brand-tint`.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `brand` and `brand-strong` fills (white in light, deep green in dark).

tokens.name: pulse
tokens.usage: Pulse Lime: the energy accent. ONE moment per screen: the clock-in button, the live-timer dot, a highlight in marketing. Never text; text on it is `on-pulse`.

tokens.name: on-pulse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `pulse` fills in both themes.

tokens.name: beat
tokens.usage: Beat Amber: the dot in the mark, breaks, pending approvals, notifications badge. Text on it is `on-beat`.

tokens.name: on-beat
tokens.usage: Text on `beat` fills.

tokens.name: beat-tint
tokens.usage: Break-time blocks, pending-approval banners. Text on it is `ink`.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Approved, on time, synced. Always paired with a check icon or word.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, late clock-ins, destructive actions; text on `bg`, `surface` and `danger-tint`. Always with an icon or word (never color alone).

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Error banners and invalid-field backgrounds.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a `danger` fill (destructive buttons).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warnings and overtime alerts as text on `bg`, `surface`, `warning-tint`.

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Warning banners.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational text and links inside info banners; on `bg`, `surface`, `info-tint`.

tokens.name: info-tint
tokens.usage: Info banners, AI-suggestion cards.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px solid ring, 2px offset in the page color. 3:1+ on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: shift-green
tokens.usage: Schedule block tint, role 1. Text `ink`.

tokens.name: shift-sun
tokens.usage: Schedule block tint, role 2. Text `ink`.

tokens.name: shift-sky
tokens.usage: Schedule block tint, role 3. Text `ink`.

tokens.name: shift-clay
tokens.usage: Schedule block tint, role 4. Text `ink`.

tokens.name: shift-stone
tokens.usage: Schedule block tint, role 5 and unassigned shifts. Text `ink`.

tokens.name: track-focus
tokens.usage: Desktop activity timeline: focused productive work.

tokens.name: track-neutral
tokens.usage: Desktop activity timeline: neutral apps, meetings, communication.

tokens.name: track-idle
tokens.usage: Desktop activity timeline: idle or away. Always drawn with the hatch pattern so it never relies on color.

families.sans: "IBM Plex Sans Hebrew", "IBM Plex Sans", "Segoe UI", "Arial Hebrew", system-ui, sans-serif
families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

tokens.name: radius-sm

tokens.name: radius-md

tokens.name: radius-lg

tokens.name: radius-xl

tokens.name: radius-pill

tokens.name: shadow-sm

tokens.name: shadow-md

tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, sheets.
